title: ROHL C2503APC 7" Wall Mount Tub Spout (Polished Chrome)

comparisons.notes: Same model C2503APC polished chrome, listed in stock (6 left)

writeup: ROHL's Italian-made C2503APC wall-mount tub spout in polished chrome is $95.99 new on Woot, while plumbing showrooms like GN Kitchen and Bath and KIE Supply list it at $191. It has a 7-inch reach, brass construction and a 3/4-inch female NPT inlet. Woot showed only one left at posting.
